mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, username, display_name, password_hash, roles_json, enabled, failed_attempts, locked_until, mfa_enabled, mfa_secret, version, created_at, updated_at FROM local_user_account WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND username=#{username}

SELECT id, tenant_id, username, display_name, password_hash, roles_json, enabled, failed_attempts, locked_until, mfa_enabled, mfa_secret, version, created_at, updated_at FROM local_user_account WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}

SELECT id, tenant_id, username, display_name, password_hash, roles_json, enabled, failed_attempts, locked_until, mfa_enabled, mfa_secret, version, created_at, updated_at FROM local_user_account WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} ORDER BY username ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO local_user_account (id, tenant_id, username, display_name, password_hash, roles_json, enabled, failed_attempts, locked_until, mfa_enabled, mfa_secret, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{username}, #{displayName}, #{passwordHash}, #{rolesJson}, #{enabled}, 0, NULL, FALSE, NULL, 1, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO local_auth_session (token_hash, tenant_id, username, roles_json, created_at, expires_at, revoked_at) VALUES (#{tokenHash}, #{tenantId}, #{username}, #{rolesJson}, #{createdAt}, #{expiresAt}, NULL)
